components.help: The components with id, name, kind (target, system, supersystem), note and cost in euro or null. There is at most one target.

kind.help: The kind: target, system (system component) or supersystem (supersystem element).

note.help: A free note on the component.

cost.help: The cost in euro for the value & cost analysis, at least 0; empty without a cost. Only system components take one.

interactions.help: The ticked component pairs a, b (unordered): these components interact.

a.help: The id of one component (the smaller of the two).

b.help: The id of the other component.

exclusions.help: The pairs a, b explicitly marked as not interacting.

a.help: The id of one component (the smaller of the two).

b.help: The id of the other component.

functions.help: The directed functions with id, carrier, verb, object, parameter, type (useful, harmful), level (adequate, insufficient, excessive; empty for harmful ones) and note.

carrier.help: The id of the component that performs the function.

verb.help: The verb of the function, e.g. "removes".

object.help: The id of the component the function acts on.

parameter.help: The parameter of the object the function changes, e.g. "plaque".

level.help: How well a useful function is performed: adequate, insufficient or excessive; null for harmful ones.

note.help: A free note on the function.

positions.help: Manually moved box positions x, y per component id; a missing id means the box sits in its automatic slot.

labels.help: Manually moved arrow labels x, y per function id; the arrow bends there.

showRanks.help: Whether the function model shows the rank codes next to the verbs.

openPairs.help: Ticked pairs a, b that no function uses yet — the next candidates for addFunction.

ranks.help: Derived rank of every complete useful function: basic (acts on the target), additional (on a supersystem element) or auxiliary (on a system component), for auxiliary with level as the shortest distance to a basic or additional function.

disadvantages.help: The functional disadvantages: every harmful, insufficient or excessive function with carrier and object names, verb, parameter and kind.

valueCost.help: Function value and cost per system component, both normalised to 0 to 10. Top left in the chart (high cost, little value) are the trimming candidates.

activeTab.help: The open tab: components, interactions, model or valueCost.

matrixComponents.help: The components in the order of the interaction matrix: target, system components, supersystem elements. View only.

placed.help: The position of every box in the function model: moved by hand or in its automatic slot. View only.

diagram.help: The drawing of the function model: box outlines, arrows and verb labels. View only.

valueCostChart.help: The value & cost chart: normalised function value against normalised cost per system component with a cost. View only.

vcRows.help: The rows of the value & cost table in the number format of the app language. View only.

openPairChips.help: The open pairs as buttons; a click creates a function. View only.

pairBlocks.help: The functions per component pair, both directions in one block. View only.

disadvantageGroups.help: The disadvantages grouped by kind: harmful, insufficient, excessive. View only.

addComponent.help: Adds a component. There is exactly one target; if one exists already, another one is rejected.

params.kind: target, system (system component) or supersystem (supersystem element).
params.name: The name of the component, may be empty.
params.command: The command as one object with kind and name.

setComponentKind.help: Changes the kind of a component. If it becomes the target, the former target becomes a system component.

params.id: The id of the component from components.
params.command: The command as one object with id and kind.

removeComponent.help: Deletes a component together with its interactions and functions.

params.id: The id of the component from components.
params.command: The command as one object with id.

setPairState.help: Sets whether two components interact. A ticked pair used by functions stays ticked; the change is rejected.

params.a: The id of the first component.
params.b: The id of the second component; the order does not matter.
params.state: ticked (they interact), excluded (explicitly no interaction) or none (not assessed yet).
params.command: The command as one object with a, b and state.

addFunction.help: Adds a function carrier → object, useful and adequate, without a verb yet. The pair gets ticked in the matrix.

params.carrier: The id of the component that performs the function.
params.object: The id of the component it acts on.
params.command: The command as one object with carrier and object.

setFunctionType.help: Marks a function useful or harmful. Harmful clears the level, useful sets it to adequate.

params.id: The id of the function from functions.
params.command: The command as one object with id and type.

setFunctionLevel.help: Sets how well a useful function is performed. For a harmful function the change is rejected.

params.id: The id of the function from functions.
params.command: The command as one object with id and level.

swapDirection.help: Swaps carrier and object of a function.

params.id: The id of the function from functions.
params.command: The command as one object with id.

params.id: The id of the function from functions.
params.command: The command as one object with id.

moveComponent.help: Places the box of a component in the function model at a fixed spot.

params.id: The id of the component from components.
params.x: Left edge in pixels, at least 0.
params.y: Top edge in pixels, at least 0.
params.command: The command as one object with id, x and y.

moveLabel.help: Places the verb label of a function at a fixed spot; the arrow bends there.

params.id: The id of the function from functions.
params.x: Label centre in pixels, at least 0.
params.y: Label centre in pixels, at least 0.
params.command: The command as one object with id, x and y.

resetLayout.help: Puts every box back to its automatic slot and straightens every arrow.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no arguments.

discardComponentIfEmpty.help: Removes a component without a name that is used by no pair and no function and returns true; otherwise it stays and false comes back.

params.id: The id of the component from components.
params.command: The command as one object with id.

select.help: Highlights a component or function in the function model; a second click on the same box or label clears the selection. View only, not stored.

params.id: The id of a component or function.
params.toggle: true (default) clears an existing selection of the same id, false always selects.
params.command: The command as one object with id and toggle.

OpenPair.a: The id of one component (the smaller of the two).
OpenPair.b: The id of the other component.

FunctionRank.rank: basic (acts on the target), additional (on a supersystem element) or auxiliary (on a system component).
FunctionRank.level: For auxiliary the shortest distance to a basic or additional function (1 = A₁); empty without a way there and for the other ranks.

Disadvantage.parameter: The parameter of the object the function changes.

ValueCostRow.id: The id of the system component.
ValueCostRow.name: The name of the component.
ValueCostRow.value: Function value: 3 per basic, 2 per additional and 1 per auxiliary function the component performs.
ValueCostRow.normValue: The function value, normalised to 0 to 10 against the largest value.
ValueCostRow.cost: The entered cost in euro, or empty.
ValueCostRow.normCost: The cost, normalised to 0 to 10 against the highest cost, or empty.
